display_en:
A child may have swallowed an unknown household cleaner
The container is nearby
A sharp chemical smell is present
narration_fil: Maaaring nakalunok ng panlinis ang isang bata. Nasa tabi ang lalagyan ngunit may matapang na amoy ng kemikal.
narration_en: A child may have swallowed an unknown household cleaner. The container is nearby, but a sharp chemical smell is present.

display_fil:
Iwasan ang exposure; ilayo ang iba
Tawagan ang kumpirmadong emergency o poison adviser
Basahin lamang ang label kung walang exposure
Iulat ang label, oras, paraan, sintomas, edad; sumunod
display_en:
Avoid exposure; move others away
Call the verified emergency or poison-advice route
Read the label only if you can do so without exposure
Report label, time, route, symptoms, age; follow instructions
narration_fil: Iwasan ang exposure, ilayo ang iba at tawagan ang kumpirmadong emergency o poison adviser. Basahin lamang ang label kung walang exposure, gaya ng lalagyang malayo na sa spill o hawak ng iba. Ibigay ang label, tinatayang oras, paraan ng exposure, sintomas at edad. Sundin ang kanilang tagubilin.
narration_en: Avoid exposure, move others away and activate the verified emergency or poison-advice route. Read the product label only if you can do so without exposure, such as from a container already away from the spill or held by someone else. Give the label, estimated time, exposure route, symptoms and age to the responder. Follow their instructions.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: May matapang na amoy ng kemikal kung nasaan ang lalagyan. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: A sharp chemical smell comes from where the container is. What do you do first?

options.fil: Kunin ang lalagyan para basahin nang malapitan ang label.
options.en: Pick up the container to read the label closely.

options.fil: Painumin ang bata ng maraming tubig para lumabnaw ang panlinis.
options.en: Give the child a large drink of water to dilute the cleaner.

options.fil: Ilayo ang lahat at tawagan ang kumpirmadong adviser.
options.en: Move everyone away and call the verified advice route.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Malalantad ka kung papasok sa amoy. Basahin lamang ang label kung walang exposure. 2: Huwag rutinang painumin nang marami. Sundin ang tagubilin ng poison adviser. 3: Tama. Iwasan ang exposure, ilayo ang iba at unahing tawagan ang kumpirmadong emergency o poison adviser.
check.feedback_en: 1: Reaching into the smell exposes you. Read the label only if you can do so without exposure. 2: Do not give a routine large drink. Follow the instructions of the poison-advice responder. 3: Correct. Avoid exposure, move others away and activate the verified emergency or poison-advice route first.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Inilalayo ni Lea ang pamilya sa amoy at tumatawag
Hindi niya kinukuha ang lalagyan sa loob ng amoy
Iniuulat niya ang ligtas na nalalaman
Tumatanggi siyang pasukahin ang bata
display_en:
Lea moves the family away from the smell and calls
She does not reach into the smell for the container
She reports what she can safely know
She says no to making the child vomit
narration_fil: Inilalayo ni Lea ang pamilya sa matapang na amoy at tinatawagan ang kumpirmadong poison adviser. Hindi niya kinukuha ang lalagyan sa loob ng amoy. Ibinibigay niya ang label kung mababasa nang walang exposure, ang tinatayang oras, paraan ng exposure, sintomas at edad ng bata. Nang gustong pasukahin ng kamag-anak ang bata, tumanggi siya. Sinusunod niya ang tagubilin ng adviser.
narration_en: Lea moves the family away from the sharp smell and calls the verified poison-advice contact. She does not reach into the smell for the container. She gives what she can safely know: the label if it can be read without exposure, the estimated time, exposure route, symptoms and the child's age. When a relative wants to make the child vomit, she says no and follows the adviser's instructions.

display_fil:
Huwag pasukahin o rutinang painumin nang marami
Huwag mag-imbento ng panlunas
Walang nakatakdang distansya na ligtas sa chemical spill
display_en:
Do not induce vomiting or give a routine large drink
Do not improvise an antidote
No fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe
narration_fil: Huwag pasukahin, rutinang painumin nang marami, mag-imbento ng panlunas, o umasa sa isang nakatakdang distansya sa chemical spill.
narration_en: Do not induce vomiting, give a routine large drink, improvise an antidote, or assume a fixed distance makes a chemical spill safe.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Sumagot ang adviser sa tawag mo. Ano ang iuulat mo?
check.prompt_en: The adviser answers your call. What do you report?

options.fil: Label kung ligtas mabasa, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
options.en: The label if safely read, time, route, symptoms and age.

options.fil: Ang hula mo kung anong lason at ang panlunas na ibibigay mo.
options.en: Your guess of the poison and the antidote you plan to give.

options.fil: Na may nalunok lang ang bata; sila na ang magtatanong.
options.en: Only that a child swallowed something; they will ask the rest.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Ibigay ang label, tinatayang oras, paraan ng exposure, sintomas at edad, saka sundin ang tagubilin. 2: Huwag manghula o mag-imbento ng panlunas. Iulat ang facts at sundin ang responder. 3: Ibigay ang lahat ng ligtas na nakuhang facts: label, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. Give the label, estimated time, exposure route, symptoms and age, then follow their instructions. 2: Do not guess or improvise an antidote. Report the facts and follow the responder. 3: Give all the facts you have safely gathered: label, time, route, symptoms and age.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_en:
On Monday:
Rehearse the information call from a fictional label
Keep the simulated scene clear of exposure
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.
